scheme_name: Jharkhand International Migrant Workers Grant Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a dependent of the deceased worker (spouse, child, parent or legal heir).
Deceased worker must be a Jharkhand resident and an Indian citizen.
Death must be certified by the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
Scheme covers deaths due to accidents, violence, natural causes, animal attacks, road accidents, terrorism, nuclear radiation, and war.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000 to dependents of deceased workers.
